zh-CN.about.title: 关于我们
zh-CN.about.what.title: 丝路新“声”是什么？
zh-CN.about.what.p1: 我们是西安外国语大学和重庆大学的学生团队。我们为来西安旅游的马来西亚朋友，做了一款免费的语音导览网页。
zh-CN.about.what.p2: 打开就能用，不用下载 App。兵马俑、大雁塔、回民街，都有马来语语音讲解。中文、英语、马来语三种语言可以随时切换。
zh-CN.about.why.title: 我们为什么做这个？
zh-CN.about.why.p1: 西安每年接待数万马来西亚游客——你们是陕西的第二大入境客源国。但我们在景区发现：讲解器大多是中文的，英语和日韩语也有，马来语几乎没有。
zh-CN.about.why.p2: 我们身边也有马来西亚留学生朋友。他们跟我们说，来西安旅游前最担心的不是吃什么住哪里，是“到了景点能不能听懂、看不懂汉字怎么办”。
zh-CN.about.why.p3: 就算有翻译软件，生硬的机翻也解释不清“地下军团”是什么、大雁塔为什么而建。而且，完全用中文思维翻译的讲解词，不太适合穆斯林游客的文化背景——这是我们自己学翻译时才真正意识到的。
zh-CN.about.why.p4: 所以我们想：为什么不做个东西，让马来语游客也能像母语者一样，边逛边听、真正看懂西安？就这样开始了这个项目。
zh-CN.about.team.p1: 我们是一群不同专业的学生凑在一起做事的组合。马来语专业的同学负责写稿、翻译、反复校对，确保语音和文字听起来自然，不是印尼语词汇混着用的那种翻译腔；人工智能专业的同学研究语音合成，让机器读出来不僵硬；软件工程的同学把这一切做成了一个网页，你们打开就能用。
zh-CN.about.team.p2: 从西安到重庆，跨越城市的合作，只为了一个目标：让马来西亚朋友在西安听得懂、逛得尽兴。
zh-CN.about.purpose.title: 我们的使命
zh-CN.about.purpose.p1: 让马来西亚游客用自己的母语听懂西安。
zh-CN.about.purpose.p2: 让每一段讲解不是冷冰冰的机翻，而是真正考虑到你们语言习惯和文化背景的内容。
zh-CN.about.next.title: 接下来我们还想做
zh-CN.about.next.p1: 继续增加西安其他景点的马来语导览，补充交通、清真餐饮、住宿信息——你们来西安用得上的，我们慢慢补上。
zh-CN.about.next.p2: 本项目为大学生新文科实践创新大赛参赛作品，非商用项目。团队成员均为在校本科生，以学术研究与文化交流为宗旨。

ms-MY.about.title: Tentang Kami
ms-MY.about.what.title: Apa itu Suara Baharu Jalan Sutera?
ms-MY.about.what.p1: Kami ialah pasukan pelajar dari Universiti Pengajian Antarabangsa Xi'an dan Universiti Chongqing. Kami membina sebuah laman web panduan audio percuma untuk rakan-rakan Malaysia yang melancong ke Xi'an.
ms-MY.about.what.p2: Terus boleh digunakan sebaik sahaja dibuka — tidak perlu memuat turun aplikasi. Tentera Terakota, Pagoda Angsa Liar dan Jalan Huimin semuanya mempunyai panduan audio bahasa Melayu, dan anda boleh bertukar antara bahasa Cina, Inggeris dan Melayu pada bila-bila masa.
ms-MY.about.why.title: Mengapa kami membina ini?
ms-MY.about.why.p1: Xi'an menerima puluhan ribu pelancong Malaysia setiap tahun — anda ialah sumber kedua terbesar pelancong masuk ke Shaanxi. Namun di kawasan tarikan kami dapati: kebanyakan panduan audio dalam bahasa Cina, ada juga dalam bahasa Inggeris, Jepun dan Korea, tetapi hampir tiada dalam bahasa Melayu.
ms-MY.about.why.p2: Kami juga ada rakan pelajar Malaysia. Mereka memberitahu kami, perkara paling membimbangkan sebelum melancong ke Xi'an bukanlah apa yang hendak dimakan atau tempat tinggal, tetapi "apabila tiba di tarikan, adakah saya faham, dan apa yang perlu saya buat apabila tidak dapat membaca tulisan Cina?".
ms-MY.about.why.p3: Walaupun ada aplikasi terjemahan, terjemahan mesin yang kaku sukar menjelaskan apa itu "tentera bawah tanah" atau mengapa Pagoda Angsa Liar dibina. Tambahan pula, teks penerangan yang diterjemah dengan pemikiran sepenuhnya bahasa Cina tidak begitu sesuai dengan latar belakang budaya pelancong Muslim — ini baru benar-benar kami sedari semasa kami sendiri belajar penterjemahan.
ms-MY.about.why.p4: Jadi kami berfikir: mengapa tidak kami buat sesuatu yang membolehkan pelancong berbahasa Melayu bersiar-siar sambil mendengar seperti penutur asli, dan benar-benar memahami Xi'an? Begitulah projek ini bermula.
ms-MY.about.team.p1: Kami ialah gabungan pelajar daripada pelbagai bidang yang bekerjasama. Pelajar jurusan bahasa Melayu menulis, menterjemah dan menyemak berulang kali, supaya suara dan teks kedengaran semula jadi — bukan gaya terjemahan yang mencampurkan perkataan Indonesia; pelajar kecerdasan buatan mengkaji sintesis suara supaya bacaan mesin tidak kedengaran janggal; pelajar kejuruteraan perisian menjadikan semuanya satu laman web yang boleh anda buka dan terus gunakan.
ms-MY.about.team.p2: Dari Xi'an ke Chongqing, kerjasama merentas bandar, semuanya untuk satu matlamat: membolehkan rakan-rakan Malaysia memahami dan menikmati Xi'an sepenuhnya.
ms-MY.about.purpose.title: Misi Kami
ms-MY.about.purpose.p1: Membolehkan pelancong Malaysia memahami Xi'an dalam bahasa ibunda mereka sendiri.
ms-MY.about.purpose.p2: Menjadikan setiap penerangan bukan terjemahan mesin yang dingin, tetapi kandungan yang benar-benar mengambil kira tabiat bahasa dan latar belakang budaya anda.
ms-MY.about.next.title: Seterusnya kami ingin
ms-MY.about.next.p1: Terus menambah panduan bahasa Melayu untuk tarikan-tarikan lain di Xi'an, serta melengkapkan maklumat pengangkutan, restoran halal dan penginapan — apa yang anda perlukan di Xi'an, akan kami lengkapkan sedikit demi sedikit.
ms-MY.about.next.p2: Projek ini ialah karya penyertaan Pertandingan Amalan dan Inovasi "Seni Liberal Baharu" peringkat universiti, dan bukan projek komersial. Semua ahli pasukan ialah pelajar sarjana muda yang masih belajar, dengan penyelidikan akademik dan pertukaran budaya sebagai matlamat.

en-US.about.title: About Us
en-US.about.what.title: What is Silk Road New Voice?
en-US.about.what.p1: We are a student team from Xi'an International Studies University and Chongqing University. We built a free audio guide website for our Malaysian friends visiting Xi'an.
en-US.about.what.p2: It works the moment you open it — no app download needed. The Terracotta Army, Big Wild Goose Pagoda and Muslim Quarter all have Malay audio guides, and you can switch between Chinese, English and Malay anytime.
en-US.about.why.title: Why did we build this?
en-US.about.why.p1: Xi'an welcomes tens of thousands of Malaysian visitors every year — you are Shaanxi's second-largest source of inbound tourists. Yet at the sites we noticed: most audio guides are in Chinese, some in English, Japanese and Korean, but almost none in Malay.
en-US.about.why.p2: Some of us have Malaysian student friends. They told us their biggest worry before a Xi'an trip wasn't what to eat or where to stay, but "will I understand anything at the sites, and what do I do when I can't read the Chinese signs?".
en-US.about.why.p3: Even with translation apps, stiff machine translation can't really explain what the "underground army" is, or why the Big Wild Goose Pagoda was built. On top of that, scripts translated with a purely Chinese mindset don't always suit the cultural background of Muslim visitors — something we only truly realized when we studied translation ourselves.
en-US.about.why.p4: So we thought: why not build something that lets Malay-speaking visitors explore and listen just like native speakers, and truly understand Xi'an? And that's how this project began.
en-US.about.team.p1: We are a mix of students from different majors working together. Malay-language students write, translate and proofread again and again, so the voice and text sound natural — not that "translation-ish" tone that mixes in Indonesian words; AI students work on speech synthesis so the reading doesn't sound stiff; software engineering students turned it all into a webpage you can open and use right away.
en-US.about.team.p2: From Xi'an to Chongqing, a collaboration across cities, all for one goal: helping our Malaysian friends understand and enjoy Xi'an to the fullest.
en-US.about.purpose.title: Our Mission
en-US.about.purpose.p1: Let Malaysian visitors understand Xi'an in their own language.
en-US.about.purpose.p2: Make every narration thoughtful — truly mindful of your language habits and cultural background — not cold machine translation.
en-US.about.next.title: What's Next
en-US.about.next.p1: We'll keep adding Malay guides for more Xi'an attractions, and fill in transport, halal dining and accommodation information — the things you'll actually need in Xi'an, one by one.
en-US.about.next.p2: This project is an entry for the university "New Liberal Arts" Practice and Innovation Competition, and is non-commercial. All team members are current undergraduates, working with academic research and cultural exchange as our purpose.

en-US.ticket.title: Terracotta Army Tickets

en-US.ticket.discountFooter: Please refer to the museum's official platform for actual policies.
en-US.ticket.t.adult.name: Full-price Ticket · Adult
en-US.ticket.t.adult.desc: For visitors aged 16 to 65. One guardian may bring up to 3 children under 16 for free (Chinese citizens); please provide the children's ID information when purchasing.
en-US.ticket.t.student.name: Student Ticket · Student
en-US.ticket.t.student.desc: Full-time undergraduates and below enjoy a 50% discount with a valid student ID (adult colleges, in-service education and online education are not eligible); please bring a valid student ID and ID card.
en-US.ticket.t.veteran.name: Veteran Discount · Veteran
en-US.ticket.t.veteran.desc: Veterans enjoy a 50% discount with the "Preferential Treatment Certificate for Veterans of the People's Republic of China".
en-US.ticket.t.disabled.name: Policy Exemption · Disabled
en-US.ticket.t.disabled.desc: Visitors with disabilities reserve through the official website / WeChat with their ID card and disability certificate, and enter through the free channel.
en-US.ticket.t.disabledCompanion.name: Disabled Companion · Companion
en-US.ticket.t.disabledCompanion.desc: For severely disabled persons (level 2 and above) who require care, one companion enters free of charge.
en-US.ticket.t.elderly.name: Policy Exemption · Senior
en-US.ticket.t.elderly.desc: Visitors aged 65 and above enjoy free reservation (Chinese citizens).
en-US.ticket.t.military.name: Policy Exemption · Military
en-US.ticket.t.military.desc: ①Active military personnel enter free with valid documents. ②Firefighters and rescue personnel (including retired) enter free with valid documents. (These visitors must reserve in advance on the official ticketing website)
en-US.ticket.t.militaryFamily.name: Policy Exemption · Military Family
en-US.ticket.t.militaryFamily.desc: Spouses and children under 18 accompanying active military personnel; families of martyrs, of soldiers who died in the line of duty, and of soldiers who died of illness; and families of firefighters and rescue personnel enter free with valid documents.
en-US.ticket.t.police.name: Policy Exemption · Police
en-US.ticket.t.police.desc: People's police enter free with their "People's Police Certificate".

en-US.pagoda.policy.1.title: Military, Fire & Police
en-US.pagoda.policy.1.body: Active military, veterans, firefighters and rescue personnel, and people's police enter free with valid documents; spouses and children under 18 accompanying active military, families of martyrs, of soldiers who died in the line of duty, and of soldiers who died of illness, and families of firefighters receive corresponding benefits.
en-US.pagoda.policy.2.title: Disabled, Seniors & Children
en-US.pagoda.policy.2.body: People with disabilities, seniors aged 65 and above, and children aged 6 and under or under 1.2 m tall enter free; severely disabled persons (level 2 and above) may bring 1 companion free of charge.
en-US.pagoda.policy.3.title: Youth & Student Half Price
en-US.pagoda.policy.3.body: Youth aged 6–18 and full-time undergraduates and below enjoy half price; group visits by primary and secondary schools enter free.
en-US.pagoda.policy.4.title: Hong Kong, Macao & Taiwan Youth
en-US.pagoda.policy.4.body: Youth from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan enjoy the same benefits as mainland Chinese youth with the corresponding documents.
en-US.pagoda.policy.5.title: Religious Personnel Exemption
en-US.pagoda.policy.5.body: Religious personnel and worshippers of the same religion within the scenic area enter free with valid documents.
